HexNote

Welcome! One-time Setup

HexNote stores your docs on your own Google Drive. To get started, you'll need free Google Cloud credentials. This takes about 10 to 15 minutes and only needs to be done once.

Team mode lets everyone in your studio open the same shared Drive folders. One person creates a Google Cloud project (about 10 to 15 minutes, free) and shares its credentials file with the team. HexNote then asks for full Google Drive access, which shared folders need.

Show me how (step-by-step setup guide)
  1. Go to Google Cloud Console and create a new project
  2. Go to APIs & Services → Library → search Google Drive API → Enable
  3. Go to APIs & Services → Credentials → + Create Credentials → OAuth client ID
  4. If prompted, configure the OAuth consent screen (External, fill in your email, skip the rest)
  5. On the OAuth consent screen page, set Publishing status to In production. While it says Testing, Google expires your sign-in every 7 days.
  6. Application type: Desktop app → Create
  7. Click the download icon to get the JSON file
  8. Open the JSON file, copy its contents, and paste below

This is 100% free. Google Drive API has no usage charges at any scale. Your credentials belong to you — HexNote never sees them.
